verdict.rationale: Mastra documents Processors that transform, validate, or control messages passing through an agent, plus a concrete PromptInjectionDetector processor for scanning/blocking unsafe input, and tool approval gating (requireApproval) to block unsafe actions before execution. This covers input validation/blocking directly, but output-side guardrails and the transform capability are only generically asserted without detailed examples. Missing for 10: dedicated output-guardrail documentation/examples, independent/hands-on corroboration of guardrail effectiveness.
